candidates.hook: Gerald callously rejects Juliana at the altar: "I cannot marry you, Juliana. You are far too plain..."
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana's father coldly refuses to defend her, ordering her to accept Gerald's decision: "Do not disgrace us further."
candidates.why: Establishes immediate high stakes with a brutal public rejection at the altar, compounding the drama when her own father abandons her.

candidates.hook: Clarissa spitefully taunts Juliana in front of the congregation: "You look like a kitchen maid who wandered into the wrong wedding."
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana drops her tearful act and firmly warns Gerald, "Do not mistake my heartbreak for your victory, Gerald", cutting just before her counter-attack lands.
candidates.why: Hooks with cruel sisterly taunts, then delivers a strong pivot where the victim stands up for herself, cutting right before the climax of her payback line.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana was just dumped by her groom for her sister Clarissa.

candidates.hook: A cold matriarch scolds Juliana in the center aisle: "Oh, don't look so wounded... You should be grateful you're at least allowed to attend the wedding."
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana delivers her impassioned speech and says "I may leave this chapel without a husband...", cutting mid-declaration before her final line.
candidates.why: Captures Juliana's entire emotional turnaround from humiliated bride to commanding the chapel room, cutting on an incomplete sentence for maximum intrigue.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana has been dumped at the altar by Gerald for her sister.

moments.desc: Gerald calls off the wedding at the altar, telling Juliana she is too plain and beneath him.
Juliana begs her father to defend her, but he coldly commands her to accept the humiliation.
Juliana turns defiant and publicly calls out Gerald for abandoning her for beauty and wealth.
Juliana holds her head high, declaring she will leave the chapel without shame.
